## Boundary Checklist

- [ ] Vercel is not used as the long-term model inference layer.
- [ ] Supabase is not used as a Minecraft resource mirror.
- [ ] MCAgent does not execute local file operations.
- [ ] Desktop remains the only real local executor.
- [ ] Install actions require user confirmation.
- [ ] Resource choices remain verifiable.
- [ ] No commercial large model is required to run v0.1.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, API keys, or private keys are committed.
